sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Civil Sectt. Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Srivastava,Amit Kumar Singh,Prashansa Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajesh Kumar,Rajnish Kumar
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Smt. Prashansa Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Anant Pratap Singh, the learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
493 of 2020, under Sections 419, 420, 468, 466, 467, 504, 506, 323, 471, 120-B IPC, Police Station Kotwali Akbarpur, District Ambedkar Nagar.
3.

The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 02.10.2020 against five persons, including the applicant, his father, a brother and other relatives, stating that the complainant's father was granted residential lease of I Biswa 12 Dhur abadi land on a part of Gata No. 108 situated in Village Budhaiepur, Pargana & Tehsil Akbarpur, which is recorded as Naveen Parti in the revenue records.

Under a conspiracy hatched by the applicnt's father-co-accused Ram Kumar, the accused persons executed as many as 17 sale deeds in respect of different portions of the Ganga Ram Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191032532/
1 land and they demolished the residential house of the complainant.
4.

entities.text: Ganga Ram Tiwari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant's involvement in two other cases has been disclosed in para 20 of the affidavit., in both of which the applicant has not yet been summoned.

5. A copy of information provided by the Tehsil Officials under Right to Information Act has been annexed with the application, wherein it is stated that no residential lease of the land in question was executed in favour of the complainant's mother.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the complainant appears to be aggrieved by execution of as many as 17 sale deeds in respect of land, which he claims to be covered by residential patta executed in faour of his mother whereas the tehsil authorities have denied execution of any patta in favour of the complainant's mother; that no suits for cancellation of the sale deeds have been filed by the complainant and that the applicant is languishing in jail since 15.09.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
8.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

9. Let the applicant-Ganga Ram Tiwari be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court, unless his appearance is exempted by the trial court.
Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Pradeep/-
